content: If KeyM_Update() is called and KeyMCryptoKeyHandlerUpdate Enabled is set to FALSE and keyNameLength is 0, the crypto key submodule will inter- pret the input data as M1M2M3 values of a [6] "SHE" key. The key_ID is extracted from M1 by extracting bit 121..124 of the input data and will search for the corre- sponding value in KeyMCryptoKeyCryptoProps to identify the KeyMCryptoKeyId and 24 of 143 Document ID 907: AUTOSAR_SWS_KeyManager Specification of Key Manager AUTOSAR CP R22-11 the associated CsmKeyRef. If found, the function will trigger the keyupdate operation.
